brand.name: Acme
brand.values: Precise and restrained — nothing on the car is there without a reason. Should look fast-looking even when parked, through stance and line rather than decoration.

traits.name: Blade headlights
traits.description: Sharp, tapered LED graphic that narrows to a point at the outer edge.

traits.name: Twin centre stripe
traits.description: Two parallel stripes running the length of the hood and roof, centred.

traits.name: Hatched shield crest
traits.description: Shield badge with fine diagonal hatching, used on the hood and interior trim.

traits.name: Rising shoulder line
traits.description: A single crease along the body side that lifts gently toward the rear.

traits.name: Graphite + single signal color
traits.description: Body finished in graphite or silver with exactly one bright accent color.

traits.name: Short front overhang
traits.description: Minimal distance between the front axle and the nose of the car.

do_dont.do: Taper light graphics to a point
Keep the body graphite or silver with one signal accent
do_dont.dont: Multiple bright accent colors on one surface

do_dont.do: One crisp crease along the shoulder
